sentences.en: We begin today with a tale of a man known as a miser.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们从一个被称为守财奴的故事开始讲起。

sentences.en: A man so unmoved by the plight of others
sentences.zh: 一个对他人困境无动于衷的人，

sentences.en: that he has become synonymous with greed and selfishness.
sentences.zh: 以至于他成了贪婪和自私的代名词。
他的名字叫埃比尼泽·斯克鲁奇。
如果我没猜错，您就是斯克鲁奇先生吧。

sentences.en: Scrooge, of course, was a character in Charles Dickens' famous story,
sentences.zh: 当然，斯克鲁奇是查尔斯·狄更斯著名小说中的人物，

sentences.en: And yes, I know it's not Christmas, but stay with me a moment.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道现在不是圣诞节，但请听我细说片刻。

sentences.en: In this 1984 film version of the story,
sentences.zh: 在这部1984年上映的电影版中，

sentences.en: Scrooge refuses to give money to a charity that's helping the poor.
sentences.zh: 斯克鲁奇拒绝向一个救助穷人的慈善机构捐款。

sentences.en: My taxes help to support the public institutions which I have mentioned,
sentences.zh: 我的税收资助了我提到的那些公共机构，
而它们的开销已经够大了。

sentences.en: Those who are badly off must go there.
sentences.zh: 那些混得不好的人只能去那里。

sentences.en: Many can't go there, and many would rather die.
sentences.zh: 许多人去不了那里，还有许多人宁愿死。

sentences.en: If they would rather die, perhaps they had better do so
sentences.zh: 如果他们宁愿死，那他们最好还是去死吧，

sentences.en: Scrooge is visited one night by some unwelcome guests
sentences.zh: 一天夜里，几个不速之客造访了斯克鲁奇，

sentences.en: who push him to question his outlook.
sentences.zh: 迫使他重新审视自己的人生观。

sentences.en: The first two remind him about his past and present
sentences.zh: 前两个鬼魂提醒他回顾过去和现在，

sentences.en: and ask him to embrace the Christmas spirit.
sentences.zh: 并要求他拥抱圣诞精神。

sentences.en: Scrooge cares more about his money than his community.
sentences.zh: 斯克鲁奇关心的只有金钱，而不是他的社区。

sentences.en: But then, he's visited by a third ghost who shows him his future.
sentences.zh: 但随后，第三个鬼魂来拜访了他，向他展示了他的未来。

sentences.en: Terrified at the prospect of his own death,
sentences.zh: 面对自己终将死亡的前景，斯克鲁奇恐慌不已，

sentences.en: Scrooge begs the ghost to allow him to make amends.
sentences.zh: 他恳求鬼魂给他一个改过自新的机会。

sentences.en: Hear me, I am not the man I was.
sentences.zh: 听我说，我已不再是过去的那个我了。

sentences.en: I will not be the man I must have been but for this visitation.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这次的造访，我也不会成为我本该成为的那种人。

sentences.en: He promises to become kind and generous,
sentences.zh: 他承诺要变得善良而慷慨，

sentences.en: But, moments later, he wakes up.
sentences.zh: 然而，片刻之后，他醒了过来。

sentences.en: Here's why we're revisiting the story of Ebenezer Scrooge.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天要重温埃比尼泽·斯克鲁奇的故事的原因。

sentences.en: We tend to think of A Christmas Carol
sentences.zh: 我们往往把《圣诞颂歌》看作是一个寓言，

sentences.en: as a parable about the dangers of shutting our hearts to other people.
sentences.zh: 讲述了对他人关闭心灵的危险。

sentences.en: But there's another lesson that comes from this story.
sentences.zh: 但这个故事还蕴含着另一个教训。
这是一个关于死亡的教训。

sentences.en: It was the fear of death that caused Scrooge to change his ways.
sentences.zh: 正是对死亡的恐惧促使斯克鲁奇改变了作风。

sentences.en: And there is a great psychological truth in that story.
sentences.zh: 这个故事中蕴含着伟大的心理学真理。

sentences.en: Many of us shy away from consciously thinking about death.
sentences.zh: 我们中的许多人都在回避有意识地思考死亡。

sentences.en: death still figures in our minds
sentences.zh: 死亡在我们脑海中出现的频率，

sentences.en: far more often than most of us realize.
sentences.zh: 远比我们大多数人意识到的要高得多。

sentences.en: And these thoughts produce an extraordinary range of human responses,
sentences.zh: 这些对死亡的思考引发了极其丰富的人类反应，

sentences.en: When Sheldon Solomon was eight years old,

sentences.en: his mother told him about death.
